lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Frost upon the glass
Silent fields below
Shadows start to pass
In the velvet glow
[chorus]
Watching stars align
Infinite and deep
Tracing every line
While the city sleeps
[verse]
Breath is turning thin
Under diamond skies
Let the cold begin
Before my tired eyes
[chorus]
Watching stars align
Infinite and deep
Tracing every line
While the city sleeps
[bridge]
Distance pulls me near
Holding back the tide
Everything is clear
With nowhere left to hide
[chorus]
Watching stars align
Infinite and deep
Tracing every line
While the city sleeps
[outro]
